comment: The ENV outputs have no fixed range: SHEVCore.cc:269-271 double the shaped 0V to 5V envelope, multiply by the LEVEL knob read as -1 to +1, and add the OFFSET knob read as -10V to +10V. The shaping at SHEVCore.cc:259-267 crossfades between an exponential table below the middle and a logarithmic one above it, with the plain envelope at the middle. The EOF B output is high whenever side B is not falling (SHEVCore.cc:435), rather than pulsing at the end of a fall. The timing circuit is modelled at component level (SHEVCore.cc:204-223), so no millisecond figures are stated here. The SHAPE CV jack is read only when it is patched (SHEVCore.cc:200 and SHEVCore.cc:254).
